title: DeJig: Aqua World
native_title: デジグ アクア・ワールド
overview: DeJig: Aqua World is a digital jigsaw puzzle game and part of the DeJig series. The game includes 20 different puzzles featuring photographs of various tropical fish, which come in both 72-piece and 108-piece difficulty levels. Pieces can be rotated and will lock into place when placed correctly, and the completed image can be viewed at any time as a reference. Completing each puzzle will unlock a bonus video of that specific fish, and there is also a movie mode where a playlist can be created of the available videos to view in sequence.
